title: LCLI-702 round-2 minors: the test header map, the CheckRule "one rule" doc block, and the CHANGELOG's single budget
description:
Filed by lore-cli's session from LCLI-702's round-2 review (three MINOR findings; factual corrections, no design call). All three are records that LCLI-702 made stale:

1. `test/check-agent-profile-capacity.test.ts`'s own header map (its tag list and case counts) does not list the 4 new `[multi-pin]` cases and still says "the 12 cases here" / "4 of 12". The map's stated purpose is that a mutation subset can be predicted from the file alone, so it must list every case and count correctly.
2. `src/core/check.ts`'s `CheckRule` doc block calls `agent-profile-capacity` "the one rule whose severity is not fixed at its call site but named by AGENT_PROFILE_CAPACITY_SEVERITY". After LCLI-702 a second rule is named by a constant (`agent-profile-pin-capacity`, `AGENT_PROFILE_PIN_CAPACITY_SEVERITY`), so "the one rule" under-describes the set.
3. The CHANGELOG's LCLI-702 Added bullet says implementation's budget "rises to 111000 ... so the new gate passes here", implying it was the only budget that had to move. `verification.toml` also moved (96523 -> 97000) because it names the same grown source (`reference/cli-contract`).

acceptanceCriteria.text: The header map in test/check-agent-profile-capacity.test.ts lists the 4 [multi-pin] cases, and its case counts match the file.

The CheckRule doc block in src/core/check.ts (the sentence calling agent-profile-capacity "the one rule whose severity is not fixed at its call site") no longer says "the one rule"; it names both rules that use a named severity constant (AGENT_PROFILE_CAPACITY_SEVERITY and AGENT_PROFILE_PIN_CAPACITY_SEVERITY).
The CHANGELOG entry for LCLI-702 names both budget moves: implementation 108000 -> 111000 and verification 96523 -> 97000.
